description.value: The Quadra Island branch of Vancouver Island Regional Library has served the Quathiaski Cove community since 1988, situated on the unceded traditional territory of the Wei Wai Kai First Nation. It is part of a large regional public library system spanning Vancouver Island and adjacent islands, and is currently undergoing an expansion to improve services. For a touring cyclist arriving by ferry to Quadra Island, this public library offers free Wi-Fi and a welcoming community space.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is the active Quadra Island branch of Vancouver Island Regional Library, opened in 1988 and currently undergoing an expansion. The OSM tag internet_access=wlan with internet_access:fee=no provides evidence for free Wi-Fi; no other cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned in either the OSM tags or the fetched website content, which was dominated by navigation menus with limited branch-specific detail. The branch URL and name match between OSM and website, supporting contact confirmation for the website field.
concerns: Website content fetched was largely navigation menus with minimal branch-specific detail; cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) could not be confirmed or denied — a direct visit or staff contact would improve the listing.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A public library with free Wi-Fi on Quadra Island is a genuinely useful stop for touring cyclists; the branch is active, publicly accessible, and part of a well-established regional library system.

blurb: Public library at Quathiaski Cove, a short ride from the Quadra ferry.
